messages.subject: inla.spde2.pcmatern() error
parts:
Hello,

I am following a code modelling spatial dependencies in nest coordinates with INLA, but I keep encountering the following error when running inla.spde2.pcmatern():

> spde2 <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh2,
+                              prior.range = c(3, 0.05),
+                              prior.sigma = c(2, 0.05))
"Error in inla.call.builtin() : INLA installation error; no such file"

I have uninstalled & reinstalled INLA from the r-INLA repos several times & restarted R with no success. Here is my sessionInfo():

R version 4.2.3 (2023-03-15)
Platform: aarch64-apple-darwin20 (64-bit)
Running under: macOS Ventura 13.3

attached base packages:
[1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods   base    

other attached packages:
 [1] fmesher_0.1.5      INLA_23.09.09      sp_2.1-2           Matrix_1.5-3      
 [5] gstat_2.1-0        sf_1.0-15          lattice_0.20-45    DHARMa_0.4.6      
 [9] glmmTMB_1.1.5.9000 ggplot2_3.4.1      readxl_1.4.2  

Any help would be greatly appreciated!

Ryan
